description: This file defines a React component for a team settings modal in Mattermost, including state management, tab switching, permission checks, and modal rendering.

methods.name: updateTab
methods.description: Handles tab switching, with warning if there are unsaved changes.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Handles modal close, warns if there are unsaved changes.

methods.name: handleHideConfirm
methods.description: Confirms modal hide, setting show to false.

methods.name: handleExited
methods.description: Resets state and restores focus after modal exit.
